tool_snapshot.name: qd_authenticate_provider
tool_snapshot.description: Looks up the Quest provider account records for an 8-digit account number. Returns every location record whose account number contains the digits; the flow keeps only exact matches.
tool_snapshot.dslContent:
qd_authenticate_provider(questAccountNumber: string) -> object
  description: "Looks up the Quest provider account records for an 8-digit account number. Returns every location record whose account number contains the digits; the flow keeps only exact matches."
  type: http
  params:
    questAccountNumber:
      description: "The caller's Quest account number as 8 digits (4-digit accounts zero-padded)."
  endpoint: "{{env.QD_API_BASE_URL}}/providers?questAccountNumber={{questAccountNumber}}"
  method: GET
  timeout: 2500
  retry: 1
  retry_delay: 300
  circuit_breaker:
    threshold: 5
    reset_ms: 30000

workflow_description_at_publish: v4: the one delivery-phase tool. Decides the fax or email destination from the channel named and any email said, against the bound account record. Returns one status plus say and ask; the destination itself is for the deterministic send.

inputVariables.name: channelSaid
inputVariables.description: The channel or destination the caller named, in their words; empty to learn what is on file.

inputVariables.name: emailSaid
inputVariables.description: The email address exactly as the caller said it, with at and dot; empty otherwise.

inputVariables.name: acct8
inputVariables.description: The authenticated account number, supplied automatically.

inputVariables.name: buildingNumber
inputVariables.description: The account building number, supplied automatically.

inputVariables.name: dheld
inputVariables.description: The delivery state held so far, supplied automatically.

inputVariables.name: acctRef
inputVariables.description: A reference to the authenticated account, supplied automatically.
